content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text addresses the Isaiah 7:14 link by treating wording and prophetic application separately instead of weighing the pressed chains together by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse — one reading requires weighing the whole pressed chain together in the D5/C5 collision, while the other permits splitting the link into separate wording and application points and calling it underdetermined when each side addressed one; I weigh the first.", "why": "It calls D5 vs C5 underdetermined by separating Isaiah 7:14's wording from its prophetic application rather than weighing the parties' chains together by footing as K-C requires."}
